subject: Run apps one at a time

messages.author: 3ab24d624ac5c680
messages.subject: Run apps one at a time
parts:
Is there a way to run apps on shiny-server one at a time?  I am currently running 5 apps on a server using Docker and the instructions here: https://gist.github.com/wch/411e2953f0258a72b9e0 but the apps occasionally fail.  I tried adding app_init_timeout and app_idle_timeout to the config file but it still fails.  I think this failure may be due to network calls within the shiny apps which may be blocking network access for the rest of Shiny Server of Docker to run.

I'd like to add into the shiny-server.sh bash script a loop that checks to make sure a given app is running correctly, and if not, to rerun it.  Since it is often the case if I try running all the apps that a few will work and a couple won't, it might be difficult to run this loop running all the apps at once, especially as I add more apps to the Docker container.  So, does anyone know if there is a way to only run one app at a time so that I can add this call to the loop in the bash script I will create?

Thanks for any help.
